summary: The people complained about manna and wanted meat. Moses felt the job was too heavy to carry alone, so God put His Spirit on seventy elders to help him lead.

story_reel.narration: Not long after setting out, the people started complaining again. 'We're tired of manna! Remember the fish we ate in Egypt? And the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic? Now all we see is this manna!' They forgot that in Egypt they were slaves. Moses heard families crying at the entrances of their tents, and he felt overwhelmed. He prayed, 'Why have You given me this heavy job? I can't carry all these people by myself. It's too heavy for me!' God listened to Moses' honest prayer. He said, 'Gather seventy of the leaders. I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them. They will help you carry the load, so you won't have to carry it alone.' So the seventy elders gathered around the Tabernacle, and God's Spirit came on them. Two men named Eldad and Medad stayed back in the camp, but the Spirit came on them too! Joshua said, 'Moses, stop them!' But Moses said, 'I wish all of God's people had His Spirit!' God never meant for one person to do everything. We each have gifts to help carry the load together.

scenes.art_direction: Families sitting at tent doors complaining.

scenes.art_direction: Seventy elders standing around the Tabernacle as warm light rests on each of them.

memory_verse.text: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can use my gifts to help carry someone else's load.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Moses needed helpers to share his load. Who in your life carries a lot, and how could you help them?
reflection_choices: A friend going through something hard

quiz.question: What foods did the people miss from Egypt?
options: Fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic
quiz.explanation: They remembered the fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic of Egypt.

quiz.question: What did Moses tell God about his job?
options: It was too heavy to carry alone
quiz.explanation: Moses said, 'I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.'

quiz.question: How many elders did God choose to help Moses?
quiz.explanation: God said, 'Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You that I don't have to carry everything alone. Help me notice when others are carrying a heavy load, and show me how I can help. Amen.

companion.message: Moses was the greatest leader I ever knew, but even he needed help. God gives every one of us gifts so we can share the work. That's how His family works!

review.notes: Omits the fire at Taberah (11:1-3) and the plague that followed the quail (11:31-34). Confirm this is acceptable.
